title: Explicit punctured-neighborhood inverse limit
statement: Let T be spectral and Z closed with compact complement. Compact open neighborhoods of Z with reverse inclusion are nonempty and directed. Their punctures are spectral compact open subspaces, the transition inclusions are spectral, compatible tuples identify uniquely with the punctured generalizations of Z, and the induced initial topology is their subspace topology. Consequently the punctured generalizations are spectral.

proof.text: Reuse the existing punctured-neighborhood spectral system and its index. Its nonempty and directed theorems provide the instances. Present its stages as ambient Opens and its maps through OpenSystem.inclusionOfLE; the subtype inclusions agree definitionally. Reuse its stage spectrality, spectral transition maps, compatible-tuple limit, initial topology and spectrality of the punctured generalizations. Compactness of an ambient punctured open follows by quasi-separatedness.
